narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A trillion has twelve zeros, plus one more, so one point one times ten to the power thirteen.
<bookmark mark='miss'/>One hundred ten trillion has one hundred ten in front, which is two more places.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The bubble missed one place, so it is ten times too small.
